parsed.internal_thinking: In a game to 5 victory points, high production and efficient building are key. I analyzed several high-pip nodes. Node 20 offers a strong mix of Brick (6), Sheep (8), and Wood (11) with a total of 12 pips, which is excellent for early expansion and roads. Node 43 has a higher pip count (13) but is entirely dependent on Wheat (9, 6, 9), which is too specialized for an opening move without a port or complementary resources. Node 42 is also strong (12 pips) with Wheat and Ore (5), but Node 20's Brick/Wood/Sheep combination provides a more flexible start for building settlements and roads. I will choose Node 20 for my first settlement.
parsed.note_to_self: Placed first settlement on Node 20 (Brick 6, Sheep 8, Wood 11). High production for early expansion.
parsed.say_outloud: טוב, אני אלך על הפינה הזאת של הטיט והכבשים. שיהיה לנו בהצלחה, במיוחד לך שון, אני פוקחת עליך עין הפעם.
